actions.add_agent_knowledge_project.desc: Lets an AI agent use a project as knowledge.
actions.add_agent_knowledge_project.prop: The AI agent ID. Get it from List AI Agents.
The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.ask_agent.description: Sends a prompt to a Taskade AI agent and returns its answer. Uses Taskade AI credits.
actions.ask_agent.props.agentId.descript: The AI agent ID. Get it from List AI Agents.
actions.ask_agent.props.workspaceId.desc: Optional. The agent's workspace ID; looked up from the agent when empty (one extra request).
actions.assign_task.description: Assigns project members to a task by their handle.
actions.assign_task.props.handles.descri: Handles of project members, without @. Get them from List Project Members.
actions.assign_task.props.projectId.desc: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.assign_task.props.taskId.descrip: The task ID. Get it from List Tasks or Find Tasks.
actions.complete_project.description: Marks a project as completed, which archives it.
actions.complete_project.props.projectId: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.complete_task_by_id.description: Marks a task as completed, given the project and task ID.
actions.complete_task_by_id.props.projec: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.complete_task_by_id.props.taskId: The task ID. Get it from List Tasks or Find Tasks.
actions.copy_project.description: Copies a project, with its tasks, into a workspace or folder.
actions.copy_project.props.folderId.desc: Where to put the copy. A workspace ID works for its home folder.
actions.copy_project.props.projectId.des: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
Optional title for the copy. Leave empty to keep the original title.
actions.create_project.description: Creates a project in a workspace or folder, optionally with tasks written as a Markdown list.
actions.create_project.props.content.des: Optional. Each line starting with "- " becomes a task; indent with two spaces for subtasks.
actions.create_project.props.folderId.de: A workspace ID or folder ID. A workspace ID works for its home folder. Get IDs from List Workspaces and List Folders.
actions.create_project_from_template.des: Creates a project from one of your Taskade project templates.
actions.create_project_from_template.pro: Where to create the project. A workspace ID works for its home folder.
Get it from List Project Templates.
actions.create_tasks.description: Adds 1-20 tasks to a project, at the top or bottom, or next to or inside another task.
actions.create_tasks.props.projectId.des: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.create_tasks.props.relativeToTas: Required for Before, After, First subtask and Last subtask positions.
actions.create_tasks.props.tasks.descrip: One entry per task (1-20). Each entry is a single line of up to 2,000 characters.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_agent.props.agentId.descr: The AI agent ID. Get it from List AI Agents.
actions.delete_task_by_id.description: Permanently deletes a task and its subtasks, given the project and task ID.
actions.delete_task_by_id.props.projectI: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.delete_task_by_id.props.taskId.d: The task ID. Get it from List Tasks or Find Tasks.
actions.find_tasks.description: Finds tasks in a project whose text contains some words.
actions.find_tasks.props.maxResults.desc: Stop after this many matches (1-500, default 50).
actions.find_tasks.props.projectId.descr: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.find_tasks.props.startCursor.des: To continue a truncated search, pass nextCursor from the previous result.
actions.find_tasks.props.textContains.de: Words to look for in the task text (case-insensitive).
actions.generate_agent.description: Creates a new AI agent from a plain-language description. Uses Taskade AI credits.
actions.generate_agent.props.description: For example: "An agent that drafts friendly replies to customer support emails".
actions.generate_agent.props.folderId.de: A workspace ID or folder ID. A workspace ID works for its home folder. Get IDs from List Workspaces and List Folders.
actions.get_agent.description: Gets an AI agent with its commands and their prompts.
actions.get_agent.props.agentId.descript: The AI agent ID. Get it from List AI Agents.
actions.get_agent_conversation.descripti: Gets one conversation of an AI agent, with its transcript.
actions.get_agent_conversation.props.age: The AI agent ID. Get it from List AI Agents.
actions.get_agent_conversation.props.con: Get it from List Agent Conversations.
actions.get_project.description: Gets a project by ID or link.
actions.get_project.props.projectId.desc: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.get_project_share_link.descripti: Gets the view and edit share links of a project, if sharing is on.
actions.get_project_share_link.props.pro: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.get_task.description: Gets a task with its date, note, assignees and custom field values.
actions.get_task.props.includeDetails.de: Also fetch the date, note, assignees and custom field values (4 more requests).
actions.get_task.props.projectId.descrip: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.get_task.props.taskId.descriptio: The task ID. Get it from List Tasks or Find Tasks.
actions.list_agent_conversations.descrip: Lists the conversations of an AI agent.
actions.list_agent_conversations.props.a: The AI agent ID. Get it from List AI Agents.
actions.list_agent_conversations.props.l: How many items to return (1-100, default 20).
actions.list_agent_conversations.props.p: Page number, starting at 1. Pass nextPage from the previous result to get more.
actions.list_agents.description: Lists the AI agents in a workspace or folder.
actions.list_agents.props.folderId.descr: A workspace ID or folder ID. A workspace ID works for its home folder. Get IDs from List Workspaces and List Folders.
actions.list_agents.props.limit.descript: How many items to return (1-100, default 20).
actions.list_agents.props.page.descripti: Page number, starting at 1. Pass nextPage from the previous result to get more.
actions.list_folders.description: Lists the folders of a workspace, including its home folder.
actions.list_project_fields.description: Lists the custom fields of a project, with select options.
actions.list_project_fields.props.projec: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.list_project_members.description: Lists the people who can be assigned to tasks in a project.
actions.list_project_members.props.limit: How many items to return (1-100, default 100).
Page number, starting at 1. Pass nextPage from the previous result to get more.
actions.list_project_members.props.proje: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.list_project_templates.descripti: Lists the project templates saved in a workspace or folder.
actions.list_project_templates.props.fol: A workspace ID or folder ID. A workspace ID works for its home folder. Get IDs from List Workspaces and List Folders.
actions.list_project_templates.props.lim: How many items to return (1-100, default 20).
actions.list_project_templates.props.pag: Page number, starting at 1. Pass nextPage from the previous result to get more.
actions.list_projects.description: Lists the projects in a workspace or folder, optionally filtered by name.
actions.list_projects.props.folderId.des: A workspace ID or folder ID. A workspace ID works for its home folder. Get IDs from List Workspaces and List Folders.
actions.list_projects.props.nameContains: Only return projects whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).
actions.list_recent_projects.description: Lists projects you have access to across all workspaces, most recently viewed first.
actions.list_recent_projects.props.limit: How many items to return (1-100, default 100).
Page number, starting at 1. Pass nextPage from the previous result to get more.
actions.list_tasks.description: Lists the tasks of a project in outline order, one page at a time.
actions.list_tasks.props.cursor.descript: Pass nextCursor from the previous result to get the next page. Leave empty to start at the top.
actions.list_tasks.props.limit.descripti: How many items to return (1-1000, default 100).
actions.list_tasks.props.projectId.descr: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.list_workspaces.description: Lists the Taskade workspaces you belong to.
actions.move_task.description: Moves a task before or after another task, or inside it as a subtask.
actions.move_task.props.projectId.descri: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.move_task.props.targetTaskId.des: The task to move next to or into.
actions.move_task.props.taskId.descripti: The task ID. Get it from List Tasks or Find Tasks.
actions.remove_agent_knowledge_project.d: Stops an AI agent from using a project as knowledge.
actions.remove_agent_knowledge_project.p: The AI agent ID. Get it from List AI Agents.
The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.reopen_task.description: Marks a completed task as not completed.
actions.reopen_task.props.projectId.desc: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.reopen_task.props.taskId.descrip: The task ID. Get it from List Tasks or Find Tasks.
The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.set_task_date.description: Sets or clears the start and end date of a task.
actions.set_task_date.props.clearDate.de: Remove the date from the task. The date fields above are ignored.
actions.set_task_date.props.endDate.desc: Optional, YYYY-MM-DD, for a date range.
actions.set_task_date.props.endTime.desc: Optional, 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS. Needs End Date.
actions.set_task_date.props.projectId.de: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.set_task_date.props.startDate.de: YYYY-MM-DD. Required unless Clear Date is on. For a single due date, set only this.
actions.set_task_date.props.taskId.descr: The task ID. Get it from List Tasks or Find Tasks.
actions.set_task_date.props.timezone.des: Optional IANA timezone for the times, for example America/New_York.
actions.set_task_field_value.description: Sets or clears the value of a custom field on a task.
actions.set_task_field_value.props.clear: Remove the value from the task. Value is ignored.
actions.set_task_field_value.props.field: Get it from List Custom Fields.
actions.set_task_field_value.props.proje: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.set_task_field_value.props.taskI: The task ID. Get it from List Tasks or Find Tasks.
actions.set_task_field_value.props.value: Text, a number for number fields, or the option ID for Select fields. Required unless Clear Value is on.
actions.set_task_note.description: Sets or clears the note attached to a task.
actions.set_task_note.props.clearNote.de: Remove the note from the task. Note is ignored.
actions.set_task_note.props.note.descrip: Required unless Clear Note is on. Taskade accepts a single line.
actions.set_task_note.props.projectId.de: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.set_task_note.props.taskId.descr: The task ID. Get it from List Tasks or Find Tasks.
actions.taskade-complete-task.descriptio: Complete a task in a project.
actions.taskade-create-task.props.placem: Where to add the task in the project.
actions.taskade-delete-task.description: Delete an existing task in a project.
actions.trigger_automation.description: Starts a Taskade automation that begins with a Webhook trigger, sending a JSON payload.
actions.trigger_automation.props.bearerT: Only if the webhook trigger has Bearer Token authentication turned on. This is the webhook's own secret, not your personal access token.
actions.trigger_automation.props.payload: JSON object to send. Each field becomes a variable in the automation.
actions.trigger_automation.props.webhook: In the Taskade automation, add a Webhook trigger and copy its URL (https://www.taskade.com/webhooks/...).
actions.unassign_task.description: Removes one member from a task's assignees.
actions.unassign_task.props.handle.descr: Handle without @, from List Project Members or Get Task.
actions.unassign_task.props.projectId.de: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.unassign_task.props.taskId.descr: The task ID. Get it from List Tasks or Find Tasks.
actions.update_task.description: Replaces the text of a task.
actions.update_task.props.projectId.desc: The project ID, or the project link (https://www.taskade.com/d/<project id>). Get it from List Projects or List My Recent Projects.
actions.update_task.props.taskId.descrip: The task ID. Get it from List Tasks or Find Tasks.
auth.description:
1. Go to https://www.taskade.com/settings/api (Settings > API).
	2. Under Personal Access Tokens, create a token with any name and copy it (it starts with tskdp_).
description: Collaboration platform for remote teams to organize projects, tasks and AI agents.
triggers.comment_created.description: Fires when a comment is added to a task. Needs a Taskade Pro plan or above.
triggers.comment_created.props.workspace: Only fire for events in these workspaces. Leave empty for all workspaces.
triggers.project_assigned.description: Fires when a project is assigned to someone. Needs a Taskade Pro plan or above.
triggers.project_assigned.props.workspac: Only fire for events in these workspaces. Leave empty for all workspaces.

triggers.project_created.props.workspace: Only fire for events in these workspaces. Leave empty for all workspaces.

triggers.project_joined.props.workspaceI: Only fire for events in these workspaces. Leave empty for all workspaces.

triggers.task_assigned.props.workspaceId: Only fire for events in these workspaces. Leave empty for all workspaces.
triggers.task_due.description: Fires when a task's due date arrives. Needs a Taskade Pro plan or above.
